title: StarBasketball
tagline: This is a real time BasketBall Betting Game. Bet on any team and win the rewards if you're right.
description: This is a BasketBall betting game , through which you can bet on NBA games in real time. Winner receives double profit. It could not be possible without Chainlink. Select a Match=> Select a Team=> Choose Bet Amount. You are all set now!  Recommend this game to your friends .  Thanks
how_its_made: I used Scaffold Eth and Chainlink for this Game. I used Chainlink Oracles, rundown API for getting real time data. It took me a while to understand Chainlink , but now I can confidently say , I can make this game better in the future. Thanks to Chainink fot there support in answering my questions.
